title: [AUG-19] Replace native confirm dialog with styled undo toast for delete
why_we_need_this: Deleting a session triggers window.confirm() — a native browser dialog that clashes with the polished jade-emerald design system. It's not customizable and interrupts user flow.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Clicking delete removes the session immediately (optimistic delete)
- [ ] A toast notification appears for 5 seconds: "Session deleted — Undo"
- [ ] Clicking "Undo" restores the session (cancels the delete API call or re-creates)
- [ ] Toast uses design tokens (--card-bg, --card-radius, --accent for the Undo link)
- [ ] Toast is positioned bottom-center, above the theme toggle
- [ ] If undo is not clicked within 5s, the delete is finalized
- [ ] window.confirm() is removed entirely
